crossRefs.note: Now Herod the tetrarch heard of all that was done by him; and he was very perplexed, because it was said by some that…
and by some that Elijah had appeared, and by others that one of the old prophets had risen again.
Behold, I will send you Elijah the prophet before the great and terrible day of Yahweh comes.
and said to his servants, “This is John the Baptizer. He is risen from the dead. That is why these powers work in him.”
They asked him, “What then? Are you Elijah?” He said, “I am not.” “Are you the prophet?” He answered, “No.”
They asked him, “Why then do you baptize, if you are not the Christ, nor Elijah, nor the prophet?”
But others said, “He is Elijah.” Others said, “He is a prophet, or like one of the prophets.”
Many of the multitude therefore, when they heard these words, said, “This is truly the prophet.”

parallels.note: They told him, “John the Baptizer, and others say Elijah, but others: one of the prophets.”

people.name: Elijah
people.line: A prophet during the reigns of Ahab and Ahaziah.

people.name: John
people.line: The Baptist, a prophet who prepared the way for Jesus

translations.web: They answered, “ ‘John the Baptizer,’ but others say, ‘Elijah,’ and others, that one of the old prophets has risen again.”
translations.bsb: They replied, “Some say John the Baptist; others say Elijah; and still others, that a prophet of old has arisen.”
translations.kjv: They answering said, John the Baptist; but some say, Elias; and others say, that one of the old prophets is risen again.
translations.asv: And they answering said, John the Baptist; but others say, Elijah; and others, that one of the old prophets is risen again.
